label: Calendar and reminders
what: Today's events and what is due, read on this Mac by a small helper app.
reads: Event titles, start and end times and which calendar, for today and the next days.
not_reads: Anything beyond what the dashboard shows.
scopes: macOS Calendars and Reminders access. macOS names the level Full Access, but the helper only reads.
steps: This helper is for a Mac. On Linux there is no calendar helper, and this service stays off.
You need the Xcode command line tools. If you do not have them, run: xcode-select --install
In a terminal in the Quarterdeck folder run: bash tools/agenda/build.sh
It builds the helper app at ~/Applications/QuarterdeckAgenda.app and signs it with its own identity.
Open the dashboard and let it refresh. macOS asks to allow Calendars and then Reminders for QuarterdeckAgenda. Choose Allow for both.
If you chose Don't Allow, open System Settings, then Privacy and Security, and turn QuarterdeckAgenda on under Calendars and under Reminders.
The helper writes its snapshot on this Mac. Nothing is sent anywhere.
revoke: Open System Settings, then Privacy and Security, and turn QuarterdeckAgenda off under Calendars and Reminders. You can also delete ~/Applications/QuarterdeckAgenda.app.
tested: Parsing tested against sample data only; not tested against the real service.
